params.fn: (function(input){var responses=Array.isArray(input)?input:[];var detailList=[];var seen={};function normalizeSrc(url){if(typeof url!=="string"||url.length===0)return"";if(url.indexOf("//")===0)return"https:"+url;return url}function extractMediaFromHtml(html){var items=[];var tagRe=/<(img|video|source)\b([^>]*)>/gi;var attrRe=/([\w-]+)\s*=\s*(?:"([^"]*)"|'([^']*)'|([^\s>]+))/g;var m;while((m=tagRe.exec(html))!==null){var tagName=m[1].toLowerCase();var attrsStr=m[2]||"";var attrs={};var am;attrRe.lastIndex=0;while((am=attrRe.exec(attrsStr))!==null){attrs[am[1].toLowerCase()]=am[2]||am[3]||am[4]||""}var raw=attrs.src||attrs["data-src"]||"";var src=normalizeSrc(raw);if(!src)continue;items.push({tag:tagName==="img"?"img":"video",src:src})}return items}for(var ri=0;ri<responses.length;ri++){var row=responses[ri];var components=row&&row.components;if(!components)continue;var layout=Array.isArray(components.layout)?components.layout:[];var componentData=components.componentData;if(!componentData||typeof componentData!=="object")continue;for(var li=0;li<layout.length;li++){var entry=layout[li];var id=entry&&entry.ID;if(!id)continue;var comp=componentData[id];var model=comp&&comp.model;if(!model||typeof model!=="object")continue;var picUrl=normalizeSrc(model.picUrl);if(picUrl){var k1="img::"+picUrl;if(!seen[k1]){seen[k1]=true;detailList.push({tag:"img",src:picUrl})}}if(typeof model.text==="string"&&model.text.length>0){var mediaItems=extractMediaFromHtml(model.text);for(var ii=0;ii<mediaItems.length;ii++){var k=mediaItems[ii].tag+"::"+mediaItems[ii].src;if(!seen[k]){seen[k]=true;detailList.push(mediaItems[ii])}}}}}return detailList})
